features.quote: remains of numerous walls, cisterns, quarried places
These people have made secondary use of the caves
A sheikh's-tomb, that of Nebi Hizqin

notes: The sheikh's tomb is 'on the upper part of the ruin' (elevation, not a compass direction), so position none. The British Survey quote in the entry ('ruins, cisterns and caves') describes the same cisterns and caves; not coded twice. 'Quarried places' not coded as pits. No plan (only photos).
